channel.title: News Board
channel.description: A personal daily news briefing: AI labs, tech, finance and Fornebu.
channel.itunes:author: News Board

item.title: Wednesday 14 October
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon starts rolling out to developers, five weeks after Google unveiled it · OpenAI employee arrested after hiding recording device in conference room · Anthropic built its own alternative to Git as its code change rate surged · Chip stocks slide after Broadcom boss likens AI investors to casino gamblers · Wall Street's big banks post good earnings, but shares still fall

item.title: Tuesday 13 October
item.description: Nobel economics prize goes to Hall and Woodford for 'smoothing' crises · IMF warns global economy nears limits of resilience, lifts UK outlook · Microsoft launches Maia 300 AI chip to cut its reliance on Nvidia · Meta launches new Muse Wonder AI models to compete with rivals · Hackers force French supermarket fridges to 50C in cyber-attack

item.title: Monday 12 October
item.description: Anthropic commits $150 million to US Genesis Mission science push · Microsoft president says AI is less regulated than milk · UK minister says AI firms must raise safety efforts as cyber defences grow · IFS warns Iran war risk threatens UK's Budget plans · Trump's Russia diesel deal draws bipartisan backlash in Congress

item.title: Sunday 11 October
item.description: Anthropic cuts internet access for all internal AI evaluations · Microsoft CEO Nadella: assume AI models are compromised, build in an emergency brake · UK must not depend on foreign AI, says Alan Turing Institute head · Fed survey: US family income and wealth rose, but debt stress grew · Norway to take record 150-million-krone dividend from Bane Nor

item.title: Saturday 10 October
item.description: Trump announces Russian diesel deal, Zelensky calls it 'a gift to Putin' · Hent recommended for 2.2bn-kroner Fornebubanen contract · Cloudflare acquires Deno, the open-source JavaScript runtime · Anthropic AI gave Philadelphia police a fake tip on a murder case · OpenAI stands by firing of three AI safety researchers

item.title: Friday 9 October
item.description: Anthropic bans abusive treatment of Claude in usage policy update · White House blocks Microsoft from a foreign worker hiring program · Oil prices jump 5% on Middle East tension and hurricane risk · Bank of England urges a credible budget as gilt yields surge · Google launches a universal Gemini agent that works across apps

item.title: Thursday 8 October
item.description: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 to everyone with a new Intelligent UI · Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5, its new fast, low-cost model · Microsoft unveils new AI hardware, gives Copilot control of Windows · Samsung posts record profit as AI chip boom lifts earnings · Canada's Weston family buys UK pharmacy chain Boots for $8.9bn

item.title: Wednesday 7 October
item.description: Paramount completes $111bn Warner Bros Discovery merger · Finland orders Google to halt work on two data centres · Hackers obtain fraudulent TLS certificates for Google, others · Norway's government unveils its 2027 budget today · Google ends free access to Gemini Flash and Pro from 9 October

item.title: Tuesday 6 October
item.description: Pentagon stops using Anthropic's AI tools after supply-chain blacklist · Anthropic's report of a user's Claude diary leads to felony charge · OpenAI claims a solution to the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize problem · Norway plans a temporary ban on smart glasses in public places · UK's average five-year mortgage rate hits 6% for first time in 3 years

item.title: Monday 5 October
item.description: Trump names intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar · OpenAI safety leader quits, warns company culture 'broken' · Anthropic commits $100 million to train 10,000 AI engineers · BT agrees deal to rescue broadband provider TalkTalk · Norway may need another rate hike as inflation stays above target
